fullPassage: Dear Principal Jones, I hope this message finds you well. As student council president, I am reaching out to discuss an important matter regarding our school library's current operating hours. At present, the library closes at 5 p.m., which many students feel limits their ability to fully use its resources for study and research after regular class hours. This is particularly challenging for those preparing for college entrance exams or working on academic projects that demand a quiet and resourceful environment. Therefore, I'd like to ask you to extend the library's operating hours to 7 p.m. This change would greatly benefit students by providing additional time to focus on their academic goals. I hope you will consider this proposal as a step toward improving our academic environment and better supporting our needs. Sincerely, Eric Park Student Council President

questions.passage: Dear Principal Jones, I hope this message finds you well. This is particularly (B)[challenging / comfortable] for those preparing for college entrance exams or working on academic projects that demand a quiet and resourceful environment. Therefore, I'd like to ask you to (C)[extend / shorten] the library's operating hours to 7 p.m. This change would greatly benefit students by providing additional time to focus on their academic goals. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
① expands: 5시 폐관이 이용 능력을 '확장한다'는 것은 맥락과 반대
② limits — challenging — extend ←정답: 원문 그대로
③ comfortable: 입시 준비 학생에게 '편안한'은 부적절, challenging이 맞음
④ shorten: 7시로 '늘려' 달라는 요청이므로 '단축'은 반대
det.tip: 글쓴이가 도서관 운영시간에 대해 느끼는 문제와 요청 방향을 파악하세요.

③ worsening: 학업 환경을 '악화'시키자는 제안이 아니므로 부적절
④ discuss — benefit — improving ←정답: 원문 그대로
det.tip: 편지의 목적(논의)과 시간 연장의 긍정적 효과를 파악하세요.

det.korean: 이것은 대학 입시를 준비하는 사람들에게 특히 어렵다.
det.analysis: those를 수식하는 분사구로, 능동의 의미이므로 현재분사 preparing을 쓴다. 뒤의 working과 병렬 구조를 이루어 명사 those를 뒤에서 수식한다.
det.tip: 명사를 뒤에서 수식하며 능동의 뜻일 때는 현재분사(V-ing)를 사용합니다.

questions.passage: Dear Principal Jones, I hope this message finds you well. As student council president, I am reaching out to discuss an important matter regarding our school library's current operating hours. At present, the library closes at 5 p.m., which many students feel limits their ability to fully use its resources for study and research after regular class hours. This is particularly challenging for those preparing for __________ or working on academic projects that demand a quiet and resourceful environment. Therefore, I'd like to ask you to extend the library's operating hours to 7 p.m. This change would greatly benefit students by providing additional time to focus on their academic goals. I hope you will consider this proposal as a step toward improving our academic environment and better supporting our needs. Sincerely, Eric Park Student Council President
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 대학 입시 / 학업 프로젝트 / 운영 시간 / 정규 수업 시간
det.analysis:
① college entrance exams ←정답: 준비하는 대상으로 '대학 입시'가 자연스러움
② academic projects: 뒤에 이어지는 병렬 어구로 이미 언급되어 중복
③ operating hours: 운영시간은 도서관의 것이지 학생이 준비하는 대상이 아님
④ regular class hours: 정규 수업 시간은 준비 대상이 아님
det.tip: 'preparing for ___ or working on academic projects' 병렬 구조에서 준비 대상을 파악하세요.

questions.passage: Dear Principal Jones, I hope this message finds you well. This is particularly challenging for those preparing for college entrance exams or working on academic projects that demand a __________. I hope you will consider this proposal as a step toward improving our academic environment and better supporting our needs. Sincerely, Eric Park Student Council President
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 추가 수업 시간 / 대학 입시 / 현재 운영 시간 / 조용하고 자원이 풍부한 환경
det.analysis:
① additional class hours: 학업 프로젝트가 요구하는 것은 수업 시간이 아님
② college entrance exams: 시험은 요구되는 환경이 아님
③ current operating hours: 현재 운영시간은 요구 대상이 아니라 문제의 원인
④ quiet and resourceful environment ←정답: 학업 프로젝트가 요구하는 '조용하고 자원이 풍부한 환경'
det.tip: 'projects that demand a ___' 구조에서 프로젝트에 필요한 환경을 파악하세요.
